text:
mika: quick heads-up — canary for sapphire-5b (qlora 4bit PTQ) showing a weird token-swap on short prompts; punctuation and question marks sometimes replaced by </s> leading to premature termination
raj: saw spikes in eos prob around step 3012, attaching mini log
raj: ```
step 3012: top_probs: [(50256, 0.63), (13,0.02), (11,0.01)]
expected top token 13 ("?") but 50256 (</s>) winning
```
elaine: can you dump logits + kv-cache for the failing run? also which kv-quant profile was used?
mika: running dumps now — config used: `--quant=4bit --fused_attn=true --kv_cache=true --tokenizer_hash=abc123`
ops-bot: deploy-canary sapphire-5b/qlora-4bit build 2026-03-19T18:22 triggered by mika
raj: hypothesis: quant rounding pushed eos id into higher logit space for certain bpe merges. another possibility is tokenizer mismatch between model artifact and runtime tokenizer version.
elaine: confirm tokenizer version: the canary runtime shipped with tokenizer v1.8, model metadata expects tokenizer v1.9 — that could cause id shifts on some merges.
mika: repro script below, deterministic for short prompts: 
``
python repro.py --prompt "What time is it?" --model /canary/sapphire-5b-4bit --seed 42 --steps 16
```
raj: running repro now — can reproduce on my host, not on long multi-sentence prompts (appears length-sensitive).
thomas: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to previous quant build, 2) force tokenizer v1.9 in runtime for canary only, 3) apply post-softmax mask to zero eos id for first N tokens (hacky).
elaine: masking eos for first N tokens is risky for general use; it might break legitimate short answers. prefer rollback + reproduce locally + proper re-quant.
mika: agreed. I'm going to rollback canary to nightly-2026-03-18 build. tagging @raj @elaine for follow-up investigation.
raj: creating a GH issue with logs, repro and sample prompts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sapphire/issues/412
elaine: I'll run tokenizer diffs and then re-quantize a small matrix (v1.9 tokenizer + 4bit configs) tomorrow morning and attach eval metrics. adding step to onboarding checklist: always verify tokenizer_hash in model.meta against runtime tokenizer at deploy.
mika: captures — also add an automated canary check: run 200 short QA prompts and assert eos probs < 0.4 in first 8 tokens.
thomas: good call. let's also add a line to release notes about tokenizer compatibility for quant builds.
mika: rollback complete, canary traffic switched back. will follow up with a short postmortem next week. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: ticket created for rollback (INC-2026-0227)
elaine: assigning follow-up to @raj and @elaine for reproductions + quant steps
raj: thanks — will post test matrix and results in the GH issue tomorrow.
